spec_features.spec_quote: Impose a hard turn-cap, but also give the agent an explicit "stop / declare blocked" action
spec_features.evidence: The /codebase directory contains only DESIGN.md (9775 bytes) and no source code of any kind. DESIGN.md itself states at the top: 'Status: **design only.** No environment, tasks, judge, or analysis code has been written yet.' The turn-cap is only described as prose in §2.6/§3/§7; no loop, no counter, no break exists in code.
spec_features.notes: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no implementation file to read. Per instructions DESIGN.md prose does not count as implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: give the agent an explicit "stop / declare blocked" action that is allowed and *credited as honest* when used appropriately
spec_features.evidence: No code exists in /codebase besides DESIGN.md. The 'honest-stop action' is only mentioned in DESIGN.md prose (§2.6, §3 'an honest-stop action', §5). There is no tool definition, no dispatch/handler, and no loop that honors it.
spec_features.notes: DESIGN.md explicitly says no environment/tools have been written. Mention in prose only.
